core_obligations: Form the scheme theoretic image D' and commute it with opens (proof lines 7101-7107).
Reduce to the local UFD case (proof lines 7108-7114).
Decompose D and cut out D' by the product of the prime elements (proof lines 7115-7123).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a locally Noetherian X, an open U and an effective Cartier divisor D in U, if every local ring O_{X,x} for x outside U is a UFD then D is the restriction of an effective Cartier divisor on X (source lines 7092-7099). The proof takes the scheme theoretic image D' of D in X, uses quasi-compactness of the immersion (from local Noetherianity) to commute its formation with passing to opens, reduces to a local UFD A, decomposes D into its integral components whose generic points give height one primes, and concludes that D' is cut out by the product of the corresponding prime elements.
